summary: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the completion of an underwritten public offering of $250 million aggregate principal amount of 6.25% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036. The notes are unsecured subordinated obligations maturing August 1, 2036, with a fixed rate for the first five years then floating at SOFR plus 213 basis points. The company may redeem at par on or after August 1, 2031, or earlier under certain tax or regulatory events, subject to Federal Reserve approval. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
